If you are interested in finance, this course is one of the most important and useful courses you should take before graduating. I would like to state that you will not find this course in any other undergraduate program in Turkey , and even in graduate programs, you will not find it in such detail. Especially after the first weeks, when you start to learn more about the course, you can become aware of real-life experiences thanks to the important professionals in the sector invited by Tolga Hoca (really, every week, different professionals attend the course). The main source of the lesson is the case scenario that we read and solved on HBR. These scenarios have been chosen very carefully and the scenarios are related to what you have studied in the class that week. In summary, I strongly recommend you to take this course, I would like to state that you will not get this much efficiency from any other course in your Bilkent life. He is an understanding and friendly teacher. He showed us many examples of the questions during the lecture. Nevertheless, his teaching method is not suitable for this course. Since this course is math and questions-based, he should have taught us how to solve the questions. However, according to his method, he shows the questions and answers from the lecture slide and passes them if no one asks the right question about calculations. There are more effective ways to teach a calculations-based course. If it was efficient, our previous math course instructors should have done it the same way instead of solving every question on the board as we should on exams. He barely solves questions on board like we should on exams. During the exams, I saw that many people I am taking the course with needed to learn to solve the questions correctly since we had always seen them on slides. This is the only weakest point of the course. Besides this problem, he is a sweet and knowledgeable person in his area. His students will be more successful in this course if he changes his method and transfers his knowledge to his students more.
